_om: Reversi in English (rusj.no/en/reversi/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen legger på måfå. Fint for å lære: The phone plays at random. Good for learning the rules.
Mobilen snur så mange den kan – og glemm: The phone flips as many as it can – and forgets the corners. A nice first opponent.
Mobilen vet hvilke ruter som er gode, og: The phone knows which squares are good and looks one reply ahead. A fair challenge.
Mobilen tenker mange trekk fram og jakte: The phone thinks many moves ahead and hunts for the corners. Can you beat it?
Mobilen kan ikke legge noen brikke – din: The phone can't place a disc – your turn again
Du kan ikke legge noen brikke – mobilen: You can't place a disc – the phone goes again
{andre} kan ikke legge noen brikke – {na: {andre} can't place a disc – {navn} goes again
Du vinner kampen – først til {n}!: You win the match – first to {n}!
You start! Play on a dot.
Klem motstanderens brikker inne mellom d: Trap your opponent's discs between your own and they flip to your colour. Whoever has the most discs when the board is full wins.
Legg brikka di slik at en eller flere av: Place your disc so that one or more of your opponent's discs sit in a straight line between the new disc and one of your own – across, up or diagonally.
Alle brikkene som blir klemt inne, snus: Every disc that gets trapped flips to your colour. A move must always flip at least one disc. The dots show where you can play.
Kan du ikke legge noen brikke, står du o: If you can't place a disc, you pass. When neither of you can play any more, the discs are counted – most wins.
Hjørnene er gull: En brikke i hjørnet ka: Corners are gold: a disc in a corner can never be flipped again.
Pass deg for rutene på skrå inntil et le: Watch out for the squares diagonally next to an empty corner – they often hand your opponent the corner.
Lots of discs early on isn't always good. Having lots of places to play matters more.
Svart begynner, og dere bytter på å begy: Black starts, and you take turns to start each round. First to 3: whoever wins three games first wins the match.
Mot mobilen på nybegynner og lett foresl: Against the phone on Beginner and Easy, ‘Hint’ suggests a move. Tapped the wrong square? ‘Undo’ takes the move back.
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Den som begynner, har de svarte brikkene: Whoever starts has the black discs. You and the phone take turns to start each round.
Whoever starts has the black discs. You take turns to start each round.
One game – whoever wins it, wins.
Den som først vinner {n} partier, vinner: Whoever wins {n} games first wins the match.
Dere spiller så mange partier dere vil,: Play as many games as you like, and stop whenever you like.
Prikker viser hvor du kan legge. Skru av: Dots show where you can play. Switch off for a bigger challenge.
Godt kjempa! Prøv igjen – eller velg et: Well fought! Try again – or pick an easier level.
Like mange seirer hver. Det får avgjøres: The same number of wins each. It'll have to be settled next time!
Vent litt – mobilen tenker: Hang on – the phone is thinking
Her snur du ingen brikker – prøv en anne: That doesn't flip any discs – try another square
Dere går til kåringen. Stillingen er {st: You'll go to the results. The score is {stilling}. A game that isn't finished doesn't count.
Partiet som er i gang, teller ikke. Dere: The game in progress won't count. You can always start a new one.
